result_text:
I changed `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` so it no longer counts cancelled purchase orders. The count subquery now has `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the other reports use. I also changed the Javadoc to say "non-cancelled". Reps with no purchase orders are still listed with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

I ran the `*PurchaseOrder*` tests and they passed. I haven't run your Anna/Bob example directly, and I didn't add a test for the cancelled case. The test run started before I edited the Javadoc, but that edit only touched a comment. Nothing is committed.
